source.version: Part 16 — Diseases, Viroids, and Microbial Ecology — Batch 01
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-09-01. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-301–305 were reconciled against current plant-pathology disease-cycle guidance; Cannabis-specific molecular diagnostics; current greenhouse disease-management review; direct Cannabis/hemp reports and pathogenicity studies for Golovinomyces ambrosiae, Botrytis cinerea, Fusarium complexes, and Pythium species; and 2026 Cannabis/hemp powdery-mildew and Pythium evidence. Public wording separates symptom, organism detection, causation, environmental favorability, genotype susceptibility, and legal product authorization.
source.note: This batch opens controlled Volume 16 with the disease triangle/cycle, powdery mildew, Botrytis gray mold/inflorescence rot, Fusarium root/crown/vascular disease, and Pythium/oomycete root rot.
